text: Rainbow Rowell's Eleanor & Park was challenged in 2013 in Anoka-Hennepin Public Schools by the parents of a high school freshman and the Parents Action League, who cited profanity and sexuality; a committee later voted to retain it. The Yamhill-Carlton School District in Western Oregon removed the book in January after parents complained about profanity and passages they said encouraged "bad behavior". The school board later agreed to convene a Reconsideration Committee, and the book stayed out of middle school classrooms and high school libraries in the interim.
